name: Uni-Language Ascendant
description: PT-BR preview: ten menu languages and the Zambrakas 2013 Emerald source profile. The fan translation retains some English text. PT-BR for the other ten editions is not enabled. Original Ascendant intro, Back and Reset profile; uninstalling deletes the mod profile. German profiles for all 11 Gen1–Gen3 editions; Emerald also French, Italian and Spanish. Requires your own exact ROMs. Based on Gen1Recomp by BOIS CLUB GAMES, LLC (https://github.com/bryanthaboi/gen1recomp)
